closeCriteria: Verify the selected Resend provider domain, sender, and production credentials
Configure the signed production webhook without using the transactional verification-email binding
Verify provider idempotency keys or reconciliation so outcome_unknown deliveries cannot be blindly resent
Pass bounce handling and production-representative bulk delivery verification
Pass newsletter reliability tests and one production-safe delivery verification
Record a successful deployed verification artifact in closeEvidence.evidence
